tools.name: archgen_plan
tools.description: Validate and analyze an archgen plan (tasks.yaml + plans/). Use after generating or editing a plan, before the verifier gate, and when you need the dependency graph or the blast radius of a change.

action.description: validate | verify | graph | impact | coverage | scaffold | brief — see archgen_help.

tasksYaml.description: Absolute path to tasks.yaml. Required for validate, verify, impact and coverage.

planDir.description: Absolute path to the plans directory (verify, coverage, brief).

node.description: Restrict the graph to one task neighborhood (graph).

format.description: Graph output format. Defaults to json.

module.description: Restrict the graph to one module (graph).

featureRequest.description: The feature being requested, in one line (brief). Defaults to the slug.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.

tools.name: archgen_tasks
tools.description: Execute an archgen plan: resolve the next dependency-safe wave, update task status atomically, list tasks, or write the resume snapshot that survives context compaction.

action.description: next | set_status | list | snapshot | contract — see archgen_help.

tasksYaml.description: Absolute path to tasks.yaml. Required for next, set_status and list.

slugDir.description: The .archgen/<slug>/ directory (contract) — locates the plan docs.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.

tools.name: archgen_docs
tools.description: Navigate the markdown artifacts of an archgen plan without pulling whole files into context. Prefer digest + section over reading a document end to end.

action.description: index | digest | section | refs | map | validate — see archgen_help.

slugDir.description: Absolute path to the .archgen/<slug>/ directory. Defaults to the active slug under the project root.

token.description: The token to look for (refs, map).

file.description: Scope to one document (repo-root-relative or slug-relative).

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.

tools.name: archgen_registry
tools.description: Keep the AGENTS.md features registry in sync with .archgen/. Call update after every task completes and after every plan change — the registry is what every harness reads to know what exists.

action.description: update = rewrite the registry from .archgen/; show = read it without writing.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.

slug.description: Upsert one feature row (update). Requires status.

status.description: Registry status for the upserted row (update).

tools.name: archgen_codegraph
tools.description: Install, wire and index CodeGraph — the source-symbol index — and its MCP server. Run once per project when .codegraph/ is missing; the index stays live afterwards, so never re-index.

location.description: Which scope to wire. Defaults to both.

approve.description: Required to write any MCP config. Without it you get the plan and nothing is written.

telemetry.description: Telemetry preference. Defaults to keep (leave as-is).

noInstall.description: Do not install the CLI; use the npx fallback in configs.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.

tools.name: archgen_setup
tools.description: Install and wire archgen: report the health of an install, wire the archgen MCP server into every detected harness, bootstrap CodeGraph (CLI + its MCP + the project index), or remove what was wired.

action.description: doctor | bootstrap | install_mcp | uninstall_mcp | harnesses | harness_info — see archgen_help.

location.description: Which scope to wire. Defaults to both.

approve.description: Required to write any MCP config. Without it you get the plan and nothing is written.

harness.description: Harness id (harness_info). Defaults to the detected one.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.

tools.name: archgen_skills
tools.description: Match a task against the capability-skill registry, install exactly the matched skill, and load its SKILL.md for prompt injection. Use before dispatching a worker whose work touches a registered capability domain (UI, accessibility, motion, design systems…).

action.description: match = which capability skills a task needs; install = install ONE capability skill (needs approve); installed = what is already installed; load = read a skill SKILL.md (or ONE section of it) for prompt injection; digest = the section index of an installed skill; list = the registry.

skillId.description: Registry skill id or slug (install, load, digest).

section.description: One section of the skill (load). Omit for the whole skill.

harness.description: Harness id to install for (install). Defaults to universal.

global.description: Install for the user instead of the project (install).

approve.description: Required to install. Without it you get the plan and nothing is written.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.

tools.name: archgen_refs
tools.description: Load archgen's own protocol documents — the interview playbook, the artifact rules, the dispatch and gate protocols, the platform capability notes and the MCP/skill policies. Pull SECTIONS, never whole files: call index for a topic, then read the section you need.

action.description: list = every reference topic with its section count; index = the section list of one topic; read = ONE section (or the whole topic); search = the sections mentioning a token.

section.description: Section slug or heading (read). Omit for the whole topic.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.

tools.name: archgen_help
tools.description: Get the detailed briefing for one archgen tool domain — when to call it, every action, and its gotchas. Call this instead of guessing an argument shape.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server working directory.
